setup.description: Install and verify PHP and optional versioned CI tools, then publish their environment.

version.description: PHP major/minor prefix or exact upstream release, including prereleases; latest/stable resolves the latest available release. Versions are discovered dynamically by the PHP backend. BSD is limited to native repository packages. Default: "latest".

installDir.description: Absolute per-user prefix for the PHP manager and isolated tool environments; native BSD packages require this to be omitted.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

tools.description: Comma-separated PHP tools, optionally name:version, such as composer:2,phpunit:11,phpstan. Blank or none skips module tool installation. Supports documented aliases and vendor/package:version with a matching executable name. Default: "composer".

miseVersion.description: mise release used to install PHP on Linux/macOS; ignored for native BSD packages. Default: "latest".
